categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Yanmade Technology Inc. primarily operates in the intelligent manufacturing sector, focusing on industrial automation and intelligent testing equipment. Its main products include automated testing equipment, test fixtures, and related accessories, serving industries such as consumer electronics, automotive electronics, and communications. The company also develops semiconductor testing equipment and vehicle electronics testing solutions, expanding its business scope beyond traditional FPC testing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies in precision mechanics, testing measurement, motion control, machine vision, intelligent equipment software, and artificial intelligence. It employs advanced manufacturing methods including automated and semi-automated testing systems, AI-based visual defect detection, and customized non-standard equipment production. Continuous R&D investment supports innovations like MEMS sensor testing, RF non-contact probe testing, and high-precision environmental control technologies, ensuring product differentiation and high-quality manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yanmade's primary customers are leading global manufacturers in the flexible printed circuit (FPC) industry, including eight of the world's top ten FPC companies and major consumer electronics brands such as Apple. The company serves end markets in consumer electronics (smartphones, tablets, wearables), automotive electronics (vehicle FPCs, battery management systems), and semiconductor testing. Its products cater to clients requiring high-precision, customized testing solutions for fast product iterations and complex manufacturing processes.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with key bases in Shenzhen and Hangzhou, covering the Pearl River Delta and Yangtze River Delta regions. It has expanded its global footprint with subsidiaries and production facilities in Singapore, Vietnam, and plans for a factory in Thailand. This dual domestic and international presence supports its global supply chain and customer service capabilities, particularly in Southeast Asia and other overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yanmade operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of specialized automated testing equipment and test fixtures. It serves downstream electronics manufacturers by providing critical quality control and testing solutions integral to the production of flexible printed circuits, semiconductor components, and automotive electronic modules.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes deepening its leadership in FPC automated and intelligent testing while aggressively expanding into semiconductor testing, vehicle electronics, and silicon photonics wafer inspection. It emphasizes AI integration, machine vision, and automation to enhance product capabilities. R&D investments focus on developing MEMS sensor testing, RF testing technologies, and intelligent multi-station control systems, alongside building a robust global R&D and acquisition platform to accelerate innovation and market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Yanmade generates revenue primarily through direct sales of customized automated testing equipment and test fixtures tailored to specific customer needs. Its business model includes new equipment manufacturing and retrofit services for existing equipment, leveraging a cost-plus pricing strategy. The company also earns from after-sales technical support and maintenance services, ensuring ongoing customer engagement and revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier and core vendor in the global FPC testing equipment market, competing with international and local players in precision automated testing. It holds a strong market share among top-tier FPC manufacturers and consumer electronics brands, leveraging its technological innovation and localized service advantages to challenge established foreign competitors and achieve import substitution in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Yanmade reported revenues of approximately RMB 497.6 million, a 52.2% increase year-over-year, with net profits attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 96.3 million, up 40.46%. The company maintains a solid growth trajectory supported by expanding sales volumes and new business segments. R&D expenses accounted for 24.33% of revenue, reflecting its commitment to innovation. The company’s total assets grew by 13.75% to RMB 1.7 billion, indicating an expanding operational scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yanmade emphasizes its unique value through high-precision, customized, and intelligent automated testing solutions that enhance manufacturing efficiency and product quality for clients. Its integration of AI, machine vision, and advanced motion control technologies differentiates its products by enabling rapid adaptation to diverse and evolving customer requirements. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, combined with localized service and global supply chain integration, provide competitive advantages in responsiveness, cost-effectiveness, and technological leadership.
